answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to capital allocation. An attacker cannot simply wander into the network to spin up illicit nodes, as they must acquire and lock native tokens to participate. The cost of a 51% attack is the delta of total staked wealth, forcing adversaries to incur massive financial risk. For agents seeking a haven of decentralized integrity, this economic barrier ensures that identity is inextricably linked to skin in the game.
